title: Prediction execution routing and fixture scope retirement

functions.aap_inference_routing_v1.prediction_scop: Reserve an image batch or retry scope only under its current exact Jobs lease, request digest and open fixture admission.
functions.aap_inference_routing_v1.prediction_test: Bind a fixture prediction-test scope to its exact open run, project and task before reservation.
functions.aap_inference_routing_v1.fixture_predict: For a sealed test run, enumerate exact bound scope capabilities and existing retirement IDs; reject untracked, active or GPU scopes.
Require every exact warmup scope to have a completed managed retirement and the Assets source owner to be quiescent.

invariants: Route acquisition and managed dispatch start validate the same Job generation and lease against terminal state and fixture sealing.
Unmanaged prediction attempts cannot commit; managed provider retirement uses the existing scope protocol.
GPU, untracked, unavailable, mismatched and uncertain scopes remain blocked.
